basis: The visitor's own person (Kevin, 2026-11-17: "the body you have riding the horse is a white man you will need to provide options for users in settings to change the gender appearance dress, etc. this becomes a person builder eventually but the foundation starts with customizing the default person"). It is nobody of the town: an anonymous figure the visitor makes, from the bodies, dress, faces, complexions and hair the town's own people are drawn with. Each year offers only that year's dress (the bodies its townspeople already wear), so the choice can never put a visitor in clothes of another time. renderers/web/js/visitor-person.js reads this file; the Settings card's You tab writes the choice.
_doc: Edit the lists to offer more; every id must be one the renderer already draws: `outfits[].asset` a body in assets/humans/web (and one test_riding seats), `cuts` a key of human-hair-styles.js HAIR_CUTS, `facial` keys of FACIAL_HAIR, `hair_colours` keys of HAIR_COLOURS, `complexions` keys of human-looks.js COMPLEXION_TINT, `eyes` keys of EYE_COLOUR. tools/test_visitor_person.mjs holds every id to its table. `defaults` is the person every visitor starts as: the figure that rode before this choice existed.
